Qwen model notice
=================

LiteratureAgent does not redistribute Qwen model weights. During first setup,
Ollama downloads the user-selected model profile directly into the user's local
Ollama model store.

Laptop profile:
- qwen2.5:3b
- qwen2.5vl:3b

Quality profile:
- qwen2.5:7b
- qwen2.5vl:7b-q4_K_M

Review the model metadata and license displayed by Ollama before use:
- https://ollama.com/library/qwen2.5
- https://ollama.com/library/qwen2.5vl

These model files are not included in the LiteratureAgent ZIP.
